name: Malchiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: This Pashur is “the son of Melchiah”, and he is not the same man as the other Pashur, the son of Immer. That other Pashur was against Jeremiah: he put his hands on Jeremiah and had him arrested, showing you he had power and he had a position. This one is sent by king Zedekiah to Jeremiah, with Zephaniah the priest, to enquire of the Lord.

note.label: SABBATH NOON CLASS: History Repeats Itself - Message From Jeremiah

points: They cast Jeremiah into the dungeon of Malchiah in the court of the prison, letting him down with cords into a place with no water but mire, and Jeremiah sinks in the mire.

note.label: Jeremiah 38: The Miry Dungeon and Abedmelech's Rescue
